items.prompt: If the same agents are permuted in the input, does the pairwise solution need a new sorting step?

options.text: Yes, the original first agent must always be spatially leftmost.
options.why: The signed differences work in either index orientation.

options.text: No, both differences reverse sign together when a pair order reverses.
options.why: Their quotient and positive-time/horizon predicate remain unchanged.

options.text: Yes, velocities must be nondecreasing first.
options.why: Sorting velocities separately would change which position each velocity belongs to.

options.text: No, because the function ignores velocities entirely.
options.why: The closing-velocity difference is essential to its test.

items.explanation: Their quotient and positive-time/horizon predicate remain unchanged.
